ModMetaData.name: Disallowed Zone
ModMetaData.author: Ordoxous
ModMetaData.description:
Paint a disallowed zone and switch it on when there's danger, such as a mech cluster, an insect hive or a raider holed up in a corner of the map.
While it's on, the zone is taken out of every colonist's and animal's allowed area, including pawns set to Unrestricted. Pawns treat it exactly as if it were outside their allowed area: they won't take work there, they walk back out if they're inside, and they route around it where they can. Drafted pawns ignore it. Switch it off and everyone's normal areas apply again.
Paint and clear it from the Zone tab. Switch it on or off from the Zone tab, the icon at the bottom right of the screen, or a hotkey you can bind in the options.
